# A quick rundown of The RULES.
We use a version of Goonstation's ruleset from 2014 to encourage a bit of lenience with our playerbase. Anything you could do back then, you can do now.
Even if you don't read these rules, you will still be punished the same, as if you did.
[bold]THIS IS NOT AN EXHAUSTIVE LIST. RULES CAN CHANGE ROUND BY ROUND. IF IN DOUBT, AHELP BEFORE YOU ACT.[/bold]
1.) Have fun! Try to have fun with other players too, and try not to be too much of a jerk if you're not a traitor.
2.) You are encouraged to be weird or spooky, but DO NOT use bigotry, racism or be sexually creepy.
3.) This game relies on trickery and sneakiness, so don't cheat by using multiple accounts or by coordinating with other players through out-of-game communication means.
4.) If an admin asks you to explain your actions or asks you to stop doing something, you [bold]really[/bold] ought to do so. If you think someone is breaking the rules, or ruining the game for everyone else somehow, use the AHELP menu to give us a shout.
4.1) AHELP is also accessible for the sake of helping you out in ways other than rule breaks. If you need assistance due to something that happened to you ingame, it's always worth a try.
5.) You must be at least 16 years old to play here. If you are younger, leave. If we catch you, which we likely will, you will be [bold]permanently[/bold] blocked from the server.
# The RULES.
## 1.) Don't Grief - Injuring or killing crew, sabotaging or destroying the station, or otherwise fucking shit up for other players without a good reason to be doing so is considered griefing. - There is a line between griefing and permissible shenanigans, but it is subjective and up to the presiding admin to decide.
## 2.) Use OOC and IC Communication Channels Properly - Don't say anything that's going on in the current round in the OOC channel, especially if it's sensitive info that pertains to the round mode. Don't try to wiggle around it by tacit or cute omission either - if it gets called out as IC in OOC, then it's IC in OOC. End of story. - OOC in IC comes up less often, and isn't as bad of an offense as IC in OOC, but it's still not allowed for the reason that it's [bold]pretty dumb[/bold]. However, this goes beyond just words - using any information gleaned from outside the round itself is forbidden. This is kind of difficult to come up with examples for given how rarely this comes up, but the main application we see is metagrudging.
## 3.) Don't Be a Bigot/Creep - Bigotry of any form isn't acceptable on the servers. This includes all "in character" communication or actions. Don't roleplay a homophobe, racist, sexist, or other bigot. - At minimum you will receive a warning or be gibbed, and if you do not stop, you could be permanently banned. There is no acceptable excuse for using bigoted language.
## 4.) Don't Metagame - You are permitted to be in a voice call or otherwise communicate with other players on the server OUTSIDE of the server, but don't operate with information you 'shouldn't' have, or otherwise cheat the roundtype. - "Something just happened to me..." counts as sharing information you shouldn't, by the way. If something happens to you, keep quiet. That's the point of social deduction.
## 5.) Don't Piss off the Admins - Somewhat subjective between admins, but doing anything that will piss them off is against the rules. This includes more direct applications such as arguing with admins, being snarky or irritating, and otherwise getting up in our faces about shit. - This also includes less direct things such as "ironically" roleplaying a racist. You can't [bold]ironically[/bold] be racist. That is not a thing.
## 6.) This Is Not Super Weenie Hut JR's - This server has an age requirement of being [bold]at least[/bold] 16 years old. Since we're not an adult only affair, you should still act modest, but don't be afraid to be a little raunchy. - If you are caught being under the age of 16, you will be banned, [bold]permanently[/bold]. If you'll lie to us about that, what else would you lie about?!
